::: {.callout-note}
**Coming soon.** A practical tour of three mechanisms that let you avoid
re-explaining things to Claude every session: project-level `CLAUDE.md`,
auto-memory, and reusable skills.
:::

## Outline

### `CLAUDE.md` (per-project instructions)

A plain-text Markdown file at the root of your project that Claude reads
at the start of every session. Use it for things like:

- Which version of Stata/R/Matlab/Julia you use.
- Conventions: naming, file structure, table styles.
- Things to never do: "Do not modify files in `raw/`", "Do not commit
  without explicit confirmation."
- Pointers: "The main analysis script is `03-analysis.do`. Tables go to
  `output/tables/` as `.tex` files."

Have Claude write the first draft for you: `/init` walks the project and
proposes a `CLAUDE.md`.

### Auto-memory (across-project preferences)

Claude Code keeps a memory store of things you've told it across all
sessions — your role, your preferences, your tools. You don't have to
manage it; it builds up. You can ask Claude what it remembers and edit
it.

### Skills (reusable workflows)

A skill is a Markdown file describing a recurring task and how to do it
your way. Once written, you invoke it by name (`/your-skill`).

You already have some good ones in your `myccskills` repo:

- **`plutonb`** — scaffold a Pluto.jl notebook for structural
  econometrics simulations (your work).
- **`evolution`** — analyze git history to show how a project developed.
- **`remind`** — snapshot the current project state when returning to
  work after time away.

For a department-facing site like this one, candidate new skills are:

- `/audit-replication` — run the [replication-package audit](../examples/replication-package.qmd)
  end-to-end on whatever folder you're in.
- `/refresh-syllabus` — update dates, readings, and sidebar in a Quarto
  course site for the new semester.
- `/clean-bib` — the bibliography cleanup from the
  [LaTeX paper example](../examples/latex-paper.qmd).

> Tell me which of these to write up first as a real worked example.
